facts.fact: Xalam Analytics estimates that Senegal had about 5 live commercial data centre facilities leasing colocation space and power to third parties in 2024, with about 1.6MW of live critical IT load, about 60% occupied by third-party customers; no facility is named in the text and telco facilities held about 60% of capacity.
